extraction.Name: Grant Cleghorn
extraction.Refused/Protested: with protest. The allottee blames only the Government for the issuance of the patent against his protest. He states that he did not want the patent issued.
extraction.Recorded patent: Yes, filed for record by Allottee
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Mortgage released by allottee; Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income whatever and no contributions.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at Otoe Agency; receipted for: Yes; wife and four children dependent upon the Indian for support; good health, no money accumulated; both witnesses of Ponca City, Okla.; notarized November 22, 1928 in Kay County, Oklahoma; notary commission expires Aug. 3rd, 1931; allottee received $4000.00 which was described as a fair price at that time; sale probably in 1918
